description: This Java class 'EmailService' provides email mailbox operations such as listing inbox, sent, drafts, trash, archived emails, searching emails, fetching email details, saving drafts, composing and sending emails, updating email flags, and internal delivery of emails within a Spring-based application.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Service class encapsulating email mailbox operations, including listing, searching, composing, sending, and updating email messages.

methods.name: listInbox
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of inbox emails for the specified user.

methods.name: listSent
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of sent emails for the specified user.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of draft emails for the specified user.

methods.name: listTrash
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of trashed emails for the specified user.

methods.name: listArchived
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of archived emails for the specified user.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches emails across subject and body fields for the specified user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Fetches a single email detail for the user by email ID.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves a draft email owned by the current user.

methods.name: composeAndSend
methods.description: Composes and sends an email, creating a sent copy for the sender and inbox copies for recipients.

methods.name: deliverToRecipients
methods.description: Internal method to deliver emails to recipient users within the system.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates flags such as read, starred, archived, and deleted status for an email.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Utility method to trim and null-check strings.

methods.name: toListItem
methods.description: Converts an Email entity to an EmailListItem DTO.

methods.name: toDetail
methods.description: Converts an Email entity to an EmailDetail DTO.
